description: Today the City of Atlanta held a very meaningful event to acknowledge the incredible leadership of our 58th Mayor, Shirley Franklin. Highlights of the day included renaming a portion of Central Avenue as Shirley C. Franklin Blvd, as well as renaming Westside Park for our esteemed former Mayor.&n
paid_for_by: Paid for by Nan for Senate
title: Celebrating Atlanta’s 58th Mayor — Nan for Senate
